steps.content: In any case, you accepted the mission yourself, so you must complete it no matter how humiliating it is, not to mention that it involves tracking down Sinners.
The stage seems to have calmed down somewhat. You lead the two Sinners to settle in an inconspicuous corner.
Yet as soon as you sit down, a uniformed waiter comes over to give each of you a "manual."

steps.speaker: Waiter
steps.content: Please pardon my late service, dear guests. Allow me to give you our proper greeting: Welcome to Ogygia Villa!

steps.speaker: Waiter
steps.content: To ensure that you enjoy this party smoothly and to its fullest, please carefully read the manual in your hands.

steps.speaker: Waiter
steps.content: If you have any questions, please let me know at any time.
